slide_reviews.copy:
You disappointed me.
For a while,
that was all I saw.

Hurt can make
one moment look like
a whole person.

I began judging
every memory
through that moment.

But pain knows
what happened,
not everything about you.
So I looked at you again.

You had disappointed me.
You were not
a disappointment.
